remarks: This charming family residence has been lovingly cared for with pride. This home presents a unique opportunity for those seeking a balanced lifestyle, with a blend of indoor and outdoor living spaces. The welcoming entry foyer leads to the main area featuring cozy ambience allowing for seamless movement between the living room, with a stone fireplace and slider door to the deck, and features pristine wood flooring, a separate ample size dining room, and adjacent charming kitchen for casual meals. Natural light warms the space with a sense of relaxation.  The two bedrooms are well-proportioned with double closets, offering comfortable living quarters, and share a hall spacious full bathroom. The lower walk out to grade level has a spacious family room with entertaining wet/bar, built-in shelves, stone fireplace and french door entrance, and a full shower bathroom, can serve as a guest room, home office, or any other purpose to suit the new owner's needs. The laundry room offers more storage area as well as an full attic. The wood deck provides an inviting space for outdoor entertaining, relaxation, or simply enjoying the surroundings.The property's location is one of Stamford's prime area's making it an ideal choice for all conveniences which cannot be beat. Commuter train station, schools, shopping center, access to major highways, all nearby provide enjoyment and ease of lifestyle.
